subject: economics
objective: What are the unemployment and participation rates?
instruction: In boom-time Lakeside everybody who wants a job has one: The labour force is 3,000, the number employed is 3,000 and the working-age population is 4,500. Unemployed = labour force - employed. Unemployment rate = unemployed / labour force. Participation rate = labour force / working-age population. Employment-population ratio = employed / working-age population. Required: unemployed, unemployment rate, participation rate, employment population ratio.
